ACCEPT — PR #13264 @ `1e1578c23dd0e18a4e45778ff36668b958ed027c` · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`)

- Clause-②: no. Internal chart layout; no export or prop moves; `ChartContainer` is untouched. No contract review is owed, and the seat read the report.
- Seat review: `AdvancedChartImpl` measures its cartesian surface with a `ResizeObserver` (a ref on the Bar/Line/Area root and the combo's `ComposedChart`). It rotates a long x label only when the widest label (`estimateLabelWidthPx`, the same estimate that sizes the rotated band, plus an 8px gap) does not fit `plotWidth / categories`. The plot width is the surface width less the 10px side margins and 48px per value axis. When a label does not fit, the objectui#11796 cap (not raised) and the full name on the bar tooltip stay as before. Before a width is measured, the length rule applies unchanged. The width changes only the axis height, so there is no feedback loop.
- Mechanism finding accepted: objectui#7385 measured nothing at runtime, so the measurement is new and local. Ruling 2's "as today" holds: the full name stays on the bar tooltip, with no tick title added.
- Pins: (a) 1044px, six stages up to 19 characters, whole and horizontal; (b) 360px, rotated and cut ("Qualificati…", "Needs Analy…"), with the bar tooltip reading "Needs Analysis"; (c) unmeasured, the length rule holds. The ablation (rotation forced on length) turned (a) red, and the restore was proven by blob. The `AdvancedChartImpl` families across charts, dashboard, report, core and types (82 files) are green.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-charts` `patch`.
- CI: all 36 check-runs completed on the head, 33 passed and 3 skipped.
- Path fork: no governed path. Seat landing.
- Findings: none.
